891-5231-8207.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

549-856-6495-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
549-856-6495-6748-6757.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3899-7084-7396.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

586-864-2267-3125-3967.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2267-3125-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Tormod.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

1812-2440-4183-7895.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Little Bear
1812-2440-4183-7895.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Little Bear with haste.
When the token Little Bear enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Little Bear trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Little Bear, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Little Bear for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Prismite twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

2173-2813-2932-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2173-2813-2932-5220.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
There's an indestructible artifact on the battlefield.
2173-2813-2932-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

112-4872-7757.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn with {3}{U} each extra turn
112-4872-7757.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
112-4872-7757.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Time Warp's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Time Warp and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Time Warp's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

3525-6006-7734.description:
Activate Wakandan Tusker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Wakandan Tusker triggers, causing you to scry 1 and gain 1 life
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Wakandan Tusker.
Repeat.

390-2523-2869.description:
Cast Hulking Metamorph by paying its prototype cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Hulking Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Hulking Metamorph dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Hulking Metamorph that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Hulking Metamorph token instead.
390-2523-2869.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-3263-6587-7638.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
2388-3263-6587-7638.description:
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

1432-4513-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color
Activate Saryth by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Saryth and Avatar Kyoshi
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-3259-6965.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2388-3259-6965.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

304-539-3899-4552-6774.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tough Cookie
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-3234-3293-5411.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2511-3234-3293-5411.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat
2511-3234-3293-5411.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1497-2173-5220-6273.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1343-2686-6337.description:
During the end step before your turn, activate The Pandorica by paying {1}{W} and tapping it, phasing out Barren Glory.
Cast Kaervek's Spite by paying {B}{B}{B}, discarding your hand, and sacrificing all permanents.
When The Pandorica leaves the battlefield, Barren Glory phases in.
Resolve Kaervek's Spite, causing an opponent to lose 5 life.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

requires.n: Extra Turn Spell - GY on Resolution

673-6333--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the extra turn spell and Planar Incision each turn.
There are at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
673-6333--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Planar Incision from your graveyard by paying its mana cost, blinking Hades and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Emet-Selch.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the extra turn spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.
673-6333--88.notes: You must use an extra turn spell that will be put into your graveyard as it resolves, not exile or shuffling into your library.

3705-4772-5231-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating two 2/2 Alien Warrior creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warriors, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1456-5078-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat

413-487.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible.
You control at least one additional creature.
413-487.description:
Give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible, if needed.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, dealing 1 damage to Sporeweb Weaver.
Sporeweb Weaver triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

3079-3860-4659-4999.notablePrerequisites:
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
Overwhelming Splendor attached to you.
3079-3860-4659-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hollow One, adding {C}{C}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Overwhelming Splendor removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.

1867-2206-4231-4772-5270.description:
Cast Gingerbrute by paying {1}.
When Gingerbrute enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Gingerbrute and the two Foods, returning Vegetation Abomination to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Vegetation Abomination by paying {2}{G}.
When Vegetation Abomination enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Vegetation Abomination and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

228-678-1069-2459.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
228-678-1069-2459.description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Rograkh.
Rograkh dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Enduring Renewal and Skullclamp.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

628-4968-5256.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 1 until Deathbringer Thoctar has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Deathbringer Thoctar.
Deathbringer Thoctar dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Deathbringer Thoctar's power.
Repeat.

2556-3617-3742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
2556-3617-3742.description:
Cast Time Walk, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall that is tapped and attacking.
Mnemonic Wall enters, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
